blends.name: 2024 Schwax Associates Raffle Tickets
blends.desc:
**2024 SCHWAX ASSOCIATES Raffle Ticket Sales Event.**
1. 1250 total tickets.
2. 25 Different batches of 50 tickets.
* 	Each batch has a **Special 1 of 1 NFT**, then 49 other tickets of same batch (Mints 2-50)  
* 	**Note:** Mint 1 was burnt of each ticket batch to offset the 1of1 unique NFT.

Prizes will range from WAX Backed, Loot back, WARSAKEN Random Loot Packs, SCHWAX Anniversary NFTs, random packs and NFTs from other collections that have been donated in the past.
**7 WAX Backed NFTs will be of the following: 500 WAX, 250 WAX, 100 WAX, 4-50 WAX.**

There will also be custom 1of1 COW NFTs from the first 8 COWs..
10% of all sales will be given to the SCHWAX Invest account to increase that portfolio.
10% of all sales will be used to buy SCHWAX Tokens and they will be burnt.

**These will be SCHWAX Associates very first 1of1 NFTs.  **
Hoping they will have awesome MP in the Spielworks Dungeon Master!!
Submitted for inclusion for the next upcoming Season!!

blends.name: COW Coin: Used Raffle Ticket Recycling Program
blends.desc:
**Welcome SCHWAX Associates!!**
This blend will allow our SCHWAX Raffle Ticket buyers to recycle their used Ticket Stubs and blend them into a new useful Item.

So in today's society, everything costs something. 
Well, SCHWAX Associates is no different.
Each SCHWAX Blend will require the use of **COW Coins**.

As our ecosystem grows, there will be more and more ways to earn, acquire and buy COW Coins.
You will be able to buy it with WAX, SCHWAX, and recycle certain old NFTs.

These COW Coin NFTs will allow us to give our Owners the ability to customize how they want to accomplish the applicable blend financially.

This will allow us to give those who gave the ability to reap a little extra from their donations and investments.
